description: This file defines the abstract class 'BaseOpenmrsData' which provides a default implementation for storing common data properties such as creator, creation and modification dates, voided status, and metadata related to voiding. It serves as a base class for other data models within the OpenMRS project to inherit common attributes and behavior.

classes.name: BaseOpenmrsData
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common properties and mechanisms for data entities in OpenMRS, including creator information, timestamps for creation, modification, voiding, and voiding metadata, with appropriate JPA annotations and support for Hibernate Envers auditing.
